column5: UI built and routed, roll is genuinely server-authoritative (no integrity issue). ★ BUT the live rail pays 4.21% MORE than the UI quotes, on every winning bet. Client diceOdds.ts:21,35 and the rules screen advertise 95/chance (5% edge, max 9500x); the LIVE POINTS rail points-game/index.ts:5354-5356 pays 99/chance (1% edge, no floor). Realised house edge on 100% of dice volume is 1%, not the advertised 5% - a 4-point margin leak. At threshold 1 under, the rules say max 9500x and the rail pays 9900x: at the 1000-point stake cap that is 9.9M paid against 9.5M displayed, a 400k gap in ONE round, and there is no payout cap on that path. The dormant money rail game-settlement:1423 uses 95/chance and AGREES with the client, so flipping REAL_MONEY_PLAY_ENABLED would silently drop every payout 4.21%. ★ The client test diceOdds.test.ts:35-38 asserts 95/chance and calls 99/chance "the old 1%-edge bug" - it is GREEN while the live rail does exactly what it forbids. Also the points rail lacks the max(1.0,..) floor and accepts thresholds 1-9999 vs the client 1-9899, so a direct-API win at 9999 pays 0.9901x, a losing win. No _shared/dice.ts exists
